heroBody: A plain-language guide to the candidates and measures on the 2026 Putnam County primary and general election ballot, no jargon, sourced from official candidate filings and ballot language.
primaryNote: Florida holds a closed primary: only voters registered with a party can vote in that party's primary races. Everyone, including voters with No Party Affiliation, can still vote on nonpartisan races (like the judicial race below) and on local and statewide ballot measures.
emptyStateBody: The guide for the next election is being confirmed. Check back soon, or see Key Dates on Voter Resources for registration and early voting deadlines in the meantime.
